# chemparseplot

> Pure-Python parsers and unit-aware plotters for computational chemistry outputs (eOn, ORCA, ChemGP, PLUMED).

Docs: https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/
Repo: https://github.com/HaoZeke/chemparseplot
PyPI / conda-forge: chemparseplot
Context7: /haozeke/chemparseplot

Import the public `chemparseplot` parse and plot API. Do not import private `_` modules.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/quickstart.html)
- [Install](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/installation.html)
- [Features](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/features.html)
- [eOn NEB howto](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/howto/parse_eon_neb.html)
- [ORCA NEB howto](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/howto/parse_orca_neb.html)
- [Tutorials](https://chemparseplot.rgoswami.me/tutorials/index.html)

## Siblings

- [rgpycrumbs](https://rgpycrumbs.rgoswami.me/): CLI, surfaces, viz dispatch
- [pychum](https://pychum.rgoswami.me/): ORCA / eOn input generation

## Install

```sh
uv add chemparseplot
# or
pip install chemparseplot
```
